title: Gameplay replay validation inside the authoritative IndexedDB write transaction
purpose: Prevent forged same-sequence gameplay history from being accepted between pre-read and atomic append.
scope: app/application/gameplay-session.mjs: replay callback bound to original world
tests/gameplay_session_browser_cases.mjs: real IndexedDB tamper/async/copy isolation tests
.github/workflows/prerelease-gameplay-atomic-append.yml: isolated Chromium profile and boot diagnostics after reproduced port failure
non_goals: No exclusive writer or productive gameplay activation
No merge, release or user-data changes
compatibility: Optional callback preserves existing atomic append API; gameplay session now supplies callback. No database version or dependency changes.
security: Read-verify-write runs in a single IndexedDB readwrite transaction; rejects forged events even with unchanged sequence and Lamport, rejects asynchronous verifiers, copies inputs to avoid validator mutation. Generic I08 append still bypasses gameplay checks.
test_plan: I08/I10 frozen regressions and prerelease matrix; known I12 Quality fingerprint blocker remains
Chromium atomic append workflow must pass on final HEAD with dedicated browser profile
rollback: Revert isolated development branch. No saved user worlds or frozen evidence are modified.
